definitions.gloss: full name, family name and given name
definitions.explanation: A person's complete name consisting of both surname and given name. Used in formal and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {氏名|しめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いてください→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{氏名|しめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}する→記入する：02624_kinyuu⟧。
examples.english: Fill in your name and address here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{氏名|しめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: I confirmed the applicant's name and address.

examples.japanese: {氏名|しめい}⟦{不詳|ふしょう}→不詳：11572_fushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: An unidentified man was brought to the hospital.
examples.notes: 氏名不詳 = name unknown, unidentified

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{氏名|しめい}、⟦{生年月日|せいねんがっぴ}→生年月日：03293_seinengappi⟧、⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}してください→記入する：02624_kinyuu⟧。
examples.english: Please accurately fill in your full name, date of birth, and contact information on the application form.

notes:
USAGE: {氏名|しめい} is a formal term used on official forms, documents, and in administrative contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {氏名|しめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}する→記入する：02624_kinyuu⟧ (to fill in one's name)
- {氏名|しめい}⟦{不詳|ふしょう}→不詳：11572_fushou⟧ (name unknown)
- ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧{氏名|しめい} (name of the person in question)

HOMOPHONE NOTE: Be careful not to confuse with:
- ⟦{使命|しめい}→使命：11445_shimei⟧ (mission, vocation)
- ⟦{指名|しめい}→指名：12868_shimei⟧ (nomination, designation)
